title: The Space inbox verify cron gives up on a failed address after 24 hours, as ADR-1732 says, instead of retrying it forever

source.ref: Scan nine (2026-10-19 weekly meta scan), docs/META-SCAN-STATUS.md

detail: listSpaceInboxAddressesToFinish picks up a failed row only while updated_at is within 24 hours, but checkSpaceInboxAddress and provisionSpaceInboxAddress save the row on every run, which sets updated_at to now even when it stays failed. So a failed row never ages out: the 15-minute cron calls the provider's verify and inspect for it indefinitely, contrary to the route header, ADR-1732 and EMAIL-022 ('an older failure waits for the owner'). Fix: key the window on a timestamp that does not move on a failed-to-failed save (a failed_at column, which needs a migration), or skip the save and the verify request when a failed row re-reads as failed; mind the cron's updated_at ordering.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('lib/comms/space-inbox-address.ts','utf8');const i=s.indexOf('export async function listSpaceInboxAddressesToFinish');const b=i<0?'':s.slice(i,i+800);if(/state\\.eq\\.failed,updated_at\\.gte/.test(b)){console.error('SCAN-1011: the failed-row window is keyed on updated_at, which every run refreshes, so a failed inbox address is retried forever');process.exit(1)}"
